title: Rawafid
description: A multilingual PHP/MySQL custom CMS platform for a community, articles, and events, delivered 3 October 2026, with 2,000+ registered users.
architecture: A PHP/MySQL custom CMS platform with separate public pages and an admin area. The site organizes community programs, projects, articles, and events for 2,000+ registered users; CSS and JavaScript support the responsive, multilingual experience.
highlights: Organize community programs, projects, articles, and events across an easy-to-manage multilingual platform.
Serve 2,000+ registered users with a responsive, multilingual experience.
Manage site content and 2,000+ registered users through the admin area.
imageAlt: Rawafid Collective website showing a community platform with articles and events

title: Tech Xpress
description: An electronics e-commerce platform focused on a smooth shopping experience, secure checkout, and order management.
architecture: A full e-commerce application built with ASP.NET Core MVC, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server. It integrates Stripe API for secure payments, includes authentication, and is deployed to Azure.
highlights: Browse products and manage orders with authentication and role-based access.
Pay securely online through Stripe API integration.
Designed for clean architecture, repository pattern, and maintainable code.

title: E-Learning Platform with AI Chatbot
description: A graduation project that helps students learn online with courses, progress tracking, and an AI chatbot.
architecture: Built with ASP.NET Core and MVC, using Identity for authentication and SQL Server for data storage. The platform supports course creation, enrollment, assessments, and an integrated AI chatbot for student support.
highlights: Create and manage courses, lessons, and assessments in one place.
Track student progress and performance with a clean dashboard.
Get instant answers and learning support from the built-in AI chatbot.
imageAlt: E-learning platform with courses and AI chatbot

title: El Wakeel Law Firm Website
description: A static website for El Wakeel Law Firm (Premier Legal Practice in Egypt & GCC), presenting 20+ years of legal advocacy, 1,500+ closed cases, practice areas, and partner credentials, with contact forms via Formspree.
architecture: A static, responsive front-end corporate website built with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and JavaScript, with jQuery and interactive carousel sections. Contact forms are handled via Formspree. There is no backend and no booking system.
highlights: Contact forms via Formspree so visitors can reach the firm directly.
Present 20+ years of legal advocacy, 1,500+ closed cases, and a wide range of practice areas.
Showcase partner credentials, legal expertise, and firm values with confidence.
Responsive gold-accented corporate aesthetic built for high performance across all devices.
imageAlt: El Wakeel Law Firm live static website showing Premier Legal Practice in Egypt and GCC

title: DevERP — Developer ERP & Cash Flow Suite
description: An offline-first enterprise resource planning app with invoicing, inventory, and cash flow management.
architecture: A modular, offline-first ASP.NET Core desktop application with a strong focus on clean code and domain design. The architecture uses domain-driven design, CQRS, and modular boundaries to keep features independent and testable.
highlights: Manage invoices, stock, customers, and cash flow from a single dashboard.
Track every payment and expense with detailed financial reporting.
Work offline with confidence, with data saved locally and safely.
imageAlt: DevERP dashboard with business and cash flow insights

title: Alkian Alsaamy — Marketing Agency Platform
description: A high-converting corporate web platform for Al Kian Alsaamy, a Cairo-based integrated marketing agency, with service pages, portfolio showcases, and a blog.
architecture: A responsive marketing website built with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. The platform uses reusable components, smooth scrolling, and structured content to present services, portfolio, and articles.
highlights: Present services, portfolio, and client results in a clean, professional layout.
Share insights and case studies through a dedicated blog section.
Convert visitors with clear calls-to-action and contact options.

title: DevERP PRO — Native .NET 8 Desktop ERP
description: A high-performance, offline-first Windows desktop ERP built on .NET 8, WPF, and SQLite — with a modern glass UI, secure licensing, and a live, modular architecture.
architecture: A native .NET 8 WPF application using MVVM, Entity Framework Core, and SQLite for a fully offline experience. The app features a modular plug-in architecture, JWT-based licensing, and automated deployment via GitHub Actions.
highlights: Fast, responsive desktop UI with real-time data and smooth navigation.
Secure licensing and activation system for commercial use.
Modular architecture with plug-in support for future extensions.
